doc.title: Jonathan Scales interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 23, 2025

title: Studio footage, headphones and in-ear monitors
summary: Rowe asks about a documentary clip of the drummer without headphones; Scales says it was likely B-roll or in-ears.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: So I was watching your documentary about being in the recording studio and one thing I saw, there was a clip of your drummer. It looked like it was a take, and I noticed he didn’t have headphones on. And I was wondering if you’re playing – do you sometimes play live together without headphones just like you’re playing a concert?
So if it was from the studio and it was footage it could be that he was just playing and that it wasn’t being recorded right then for the album. More than likely. It could have been just like B-roll.

Yeah you know like the videographer was probably like in the room and which probably wouldn’t have happened if he was really recording. So whatever clip that was in particular there’s a chance that he wasn’t actually tracking in that moment, and maybe he was just going through some stuff or working on something.
Yeah. But he did a good job with it because when he was done he like [gasps]. He stuck his tongue out and was gasping.

Okay I think I know what you’re talking about. That shot might have actually been from the other room so I think that was a real take. So he might also have in-ear monitors too. They might have been in his ears like that.
